builds.hypothesis: All five bolts double180+0.45 AP into360+0.9 AP magic. AP/penetration support close hit; souls do not directly scale Q. Deathcap amplifies AP; Shadowflame supplies15 flat magic penetration/conditional lowHP magic-true amplification; Void supplies40% MR penetration; Banshee/Zhonya supply105 AP each; Riftmaker supplies HP-to-AP and verified8% combat ramp.

buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.
